_설명: 천일문 3권 Chapter 11 일치와 화법 Chapter Test 뒷부분(15~21번)에서 가져와 변형한 문항. 심화 11과 일치와 화법 자리에 합쳐 둔다.

questions.prompt: 다음 중 어법상 알맞은 말을 한 학생끼리 바르게 짝지어진 것을 고르세요.
body: 준서: Fifty dollars is my weekly allowance.
서아: All of my family members are good at Chinese.
한나: Most of my free time are spent on playing games.
성환: Physics are the hardest subject for me.
창훈: The Netherlands is the country where I spent my childhood.

questions.prompt: 다음 문장을 주어진 단어를 사용하여 간접화법으로 바꿔 쓰세요.
body: The teacher said to her, “Are you feeling sick?” (ask, if)
questions.answer: The teacher asked her if she was feeling sick

questions.prompt: 다음 문장을 주어진 단어를 사용하여 간접화법으로 바꿔 쓰세요.
body: Mom said to me, “Don’t be late.” (tell, not)
questions.answer: Mom told me not to be late

questions.prompt: 다음 문장을 주어진 단어를 사용하여 간접화법으로 바꿔 쓰세요.
body: Mia said to me, “Where are you staying tomorrow?” (ask, the next day)
questions.answer: Mia asked me where I was staying the next day

questions.prompt: 다음 중 어법상 알맞은 문장의 개수를 고르세요.
body: ⓐ I didn’t know Harry was taller than me.
ⓑ I just realized that I left my wallet at home.
ⓒ What I’m worried about is the final grade.
ⓓ Did you hear that a new student come today?
ⓔ Only 10 percent of people agrees with the plan.
ⓕ Buying things online sometimes cost less than in stores.
<조건> • 명사절을 이끄는 접속사 whether로 시작할 것  • be동사는 축약형으로 쓸 것  • the rumor, true, certain을 사용하여 일곱 단어로 쓸 것
questions.answer: Whether the rumor is true isn’t certain

questions.prompt: 다음 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 알맞지 않은 것을 고르세요.
body: My brother and I ① [[were watching]] the news yesterday. The news said that there ② [[had been]] a storm. One of our cousins ③ [[were living]] in that area, so we were worried. We asked them if they ④ [[were]] okay on the phone. Fortunately, they told us that there ⑤ [[had been]] little damage.
